rootCause.summary: Hybrid quality gate filtered SIBLING_GEOMETRY_OVERLAP using polygon-clipping area > overlapToleranceKm2 while national evidence uses validateGeometryDataset sibling checks; sub-threshold overlaps still failed independent validation. CLI hybrid OSM options diverged from national (missing maxTerritories, legacy smart fallback default true).
fixes: countStrictSiblingGeometryOverlaps for effectiveSiblingOverlap gate and prevalidated re-carve trigger
CLI resolveOsmBarrierGeneratedOptions aligned with national maxTerritories and fallbackToLegacyOnSmartFailure false

rc8NationalBuild.note: Clean directory; no restore from candidate-rc8 @4 checkpoints. Observed 2026-10-15 session — re-count districts before final sign-off.

ciBlockerHybridTest.strategy: Committed ODbL OSM barrier fixtures under packages/generators/test/fixtures/national-blocker-districts when inputs absent locally; NOT_RUN_MISSING_REAL_ARTIFACT when neither local nor fixture artifacts exist.
